clubs.note: TWO THINGS, 2026-09-30, in the Spain pass. (1) NOT AN ERROR, AND DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED: the Monaco shape. The country check flags this club every run because Wikidata's P17 on Q1386854 is Q228 Andorra, not Spain, and that is TRUE. clubs.name: RC Celta Fortuna
clubs.note: ON THE MAP THROUGH THE HAND-NAMED FALLBACK, 2026-09-30, in the Spain pass - tier 2 by hand, reviewable, the FC Wil standard; and GROUND BY HAND. Celta Vigo's reserve side, promoted from the Primera Federacion in 2026. The only P118 on Q2311865 is Segunda Division B (Q751826), not mapped, so no query returned it. Tier: the complete 2026-27 Segunda Division article (22 of 22) lists it and its Team changes table among the promoted clubs, the complete La Liga article does not, and its English article says it 'competes in the Segunda Division'. Ground: Wikidata's P115 is the Campo Municipal de Barreiro (Q3393440, 1,500), and so is its Spanish infobox, on a 2025-26 season line; the 2026-27 Segunda Division table, its English infobox and StadiumDB (which lists Balaidos for 'Celta de Vigo, Celta Fortuna') all say Balaidos. Three against two, the newer three, so it is drawn at Balaidos, at Q1326578's own P625 - a genuine shared pin with the first team, like the German reserve sides. Capacity 24,870 is the same figure as on RC Celta de Vigo's row for the same ground (Wikidata and the La Liga table agree; StadiumDB's 22,904 not taken). Emptying the ground cells puts it back at Barreiro.

clubs.note: GROUND PINNED, 2026-09-30, in the Spain pass - the SC Freiburg shape. Q8780 carries two P115 values at the same rank, the RCDE Stadium (Q473223) and the Estadi de Sarria (Q1325234, which carries P576 1997 and an end date on the statement the club query does not read), so fetch_clubs.py keeps whichever the query service returns first and the ground could change between rebuilds, or mix one ground's name with the other's figures. The RCDE Stadium is the ground on three sources and more: the 2026-27 La Liga table, StadiumDB, both club infoboxes, and Sarria was demolished in 1997. The position is Q473223's own P625. CAPACITY IS CONTESTED AND IS PINNED ONLY TO STOP IT FLAPPING, not settled: 40,500 is the figure the map already held (Wikidata's for the ground, and the ground's English infobox). Not taken: 37,776 (the La Liga table and StadiumDB, exactly), 40,000 (the club's English infobox), 40,445 (its Spanish infobox). Two and two - the AEL shape - so nothing was chosen between them.
